environment: scripts/e2e.ps1 isolated preview API/World/Vite; existing local Docker SFU; Playwright Chromium mobile emulation; synthetic browser media devices; CDP touch input
assertions: a mobile-sized participant receives microphone, camera, and shared-screen media from a desktop peer through the SFU
the compact camera pane starts at or below 128x220 pixels and the shared-screen video remains wider than 200 pixels without page overflow
real CDP touch events move and resize both floating panes while keeping them inside the world stage
touching an overlapping pane brings that pane to the front so its controls can be used
incoming and outgoing microphone and camera RTP continue during pane interaction
the mobile camera and shared-screen panes have zero axe WCAG 2.1 A/AA violations
the desktop SFU regression still passes screen-window drag, resize, volume adjustment, receiver revocation, and leave cleanup
limitations: The mobile browser uses viewport emulation and synthetic Playwright media devices, not a physical phone.
No iOS/Android Safari, real hardware permissions, external UDP/TURN path, or 100-person media-capacity check was performed.
The production build retains the existing large Phaser bundle warning.
